events.title: Outbreak Z is at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: 🧟 Outbreak Z is at Steam Next Fest! Hey, survivors! We're excited to share that Outbreak Z is participating in Steam Next Fest, happening right now! 🎉 If you haven't had a chance to try the demo yet, this is the perfect opportunity to jump in, assemble your squad, and take on the zombie hordes! Already played the demo? We'd love to see you come back for another run! We've been listening to your feedback and rolling out improvements, so there's plenty of reason to give it another shot. events.title: Update: Synthesis Improvements, Loot Rewards & Bug Fixes
events.summary: Update: Synthesis Improvements, Loot Rewards & Bug Fixes Hey, survivors! We've got another round of improvements for Outbreak Z! This update makes managing your loot and synthesizing items more convenient, gives you clearer feedback on your rewards, and fixes a few UI issues along the way. Thanks for continuing to share your feedback and helping us make the game better. Here's what's changed! ✨ New Features Synthesis Auto-Fill Filling your Synthesis inputs just got easier!
